description: Auditor binding spec for per-corner vertical load claims. Binds each of the three rigid-body equilibrium residual channels to the auditor's certificate primitive and the rational_band comparator. Epsilon is the auditor's declared tolerance for physical inconsistency in a published load set, in newtons (vertical) and newton-metres (pitch, roll); it is authority-pinned here and is NOT readable or writable from the bundle. A producer who loosens its own tolerance changes nothing. A FOURTH type, corner_load_transfer_split_residual, binds the front/rear split of lateral load transfer to an offline calibration; its epsilon (0.05, dimensionless) is the auditor's tolerance on that share, authority-pinned here exactly like the three residual epsilons. That channel is weaker in kind than the three residuals: it establishes agreement with a reference the producer supplied, not physical admissibility.
